title: AddressBook/set args
description: Arguments for AddressBook/set (RFC 9610 §5.3). Creates, updates, or destroys AddressBook objects.

accountId.description: The account to apply changes to.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard. Fails with stateMismatch if the AddressBook state differs.

create.description: Map of client-assigned creation ids to AddressBookCreate objects.

update.description: Map of AddressBookId to PatchObject. Only explicitly listed properties are changed.

onDestroyRemoveContents.description: If true, also destroy all ContactCards in the address book. Default false.
